title: Artifact for "Absolute Capture Time Policies in a WebRTC SFU: Measurement Bias and Timestamp Availability under a Wrong Clock Estimate"
description: Measurement harness, pre-registrations, raw data, and analysis scripts for controlled comparisons of Absolute Capture Time (ACT) forwarding policies, rewrite versus verbatim, on a pinned LiveKit SFU. Contains the run scripts and patch series; four pre-registration documents; per-run and per-observation raw JSON for 80 retained replication runs, 20 C0-DSRPT runs, 20 registered mid-session onset runs, 6 exploratory calibration runs and 10 apparatus-reproduction runs, with failed attempts retained; and both the superseded and corrected frame-matching analyses. Harness code is licensed Apache-2.0; results and analysis outputs are licensed CC-BY-4.0. The manuscript is not included in this deposit.
